subsystem: Voice / STT / TTS Subsystem Bug Ledger

bugs.title: Legacy Voice Loop Bypassed Main Agent Model Via Keyword Router
bugs.root_cause: Spoken utterances were routed to self.brain.execute_smart_skill(command_to_run), bypassing query_llm and creating a divergent tool-calling architecture for voice vs typed text.
bugs.fix_applied: Replaced execute_smart_skill in FridayVoiceLoop.run with direct await self.brain.query_llm(command_to_run, stream_to_ui=True, stream_to_speech=True), achieving 100% architectural parity with typed chat.

bugs.title: Lack of Acoustic Barge-In Interruption During Assistant Speech
bugs.root_cause: FridayVoiceLoop._record_phrase_impl slept and discarded audio frames while self.tts.is_speaking was True, forcing users to wait until long speeches finished or press physical hotkeys.
bugs.fix_applied: Integrated voice_interruption_controller.check_barge_in into _record_phrase_impl, dynamically checking frame RMS against baseline threshold (RMS >= baseline * 2.8) and triggering self.tts.stop_speaking() instantly on interruption.

bugs.title: Internal Thoughts and Tool Execution Traces Leaked to TTS Audio
bugs.root_cause: Regex in clean_text_for_speech omitted <think>...</think> tags and [TOOL: ...] execution fences, causing internal model reasoning and system provenance to be spoken aloud.
bugs.fix_applied: Added strict regex scrubbers for <think>[\s\S]*?</think>, \[(?:TOOL|TRACE|ACTION|RESULT)[\s\S]*?\], CRLF code fences, backticks, and emojis.

bugs.title: Transient Key Clicks and Taps Inadvertently Accepted Due to Pre-Roll Length
bugs.root_cause: Adding pre-roll buffer chunks artificially inflated total_samples above 0.20s even when active speech duration was a single 50ms click.
bugs.fix_applied: Calculated active speech duration strictly between speech onset and silence onset (active_speech_sec = end_time - speech_start_time), rejecting clicks < 0.20s without pre-roll bias.

bugs.title: PortAudio Use-After-Close Panic on Rapid Loop Stopping
bugs.root_cause: Cancelling the voice loop while the worker thread was blocked inside stream.read() closed the stream device out from under PortAudio, causing C library crashes (-9977).
bugs.fix_applied: Added _reader_idle threading.Event synchronization, waiting up to 3.0s for the reader thread to exit before calling stream_cm.__exit__().

bugs.title: Duplicate Utterance Execution on Rapid VAD Acoustic Echoes
bugs.root_cause: Rapid back-to-back triggers or speaker acoustic rebound could re-submit the same voice command within sub-second intervals.
bugs.fix_applied: Built TranscriptDeduplicator with normalized punctuation stripping, 2.5s temporal suppression window, and substring echo defense.

bugs.title: Spoken Instructions Bypassed Security Scrutiny
bugs.root_cause: Voice transcripts lacked zero-trust vetting for prompt injection and destructive OS commands prior to agent dispatch.
bugs.fix_applied: Implemented VoiceSecurityGate evaluating all transcripts against prompt injection heuristics and destructive system commands.
